title: Expansive homeomorphisms on complexity quasi-metric spaces
summary: The complexity quasi-metric of Schellekens is a topological framework in which the asymmetry of computational comparisons -- ``$A$ is at most as fast as $B$'' carrying different information than ``$B$ is at most as slow as $A$'' -- is built into the distance itself. This paper develops the theory of expansive homeomorphisms on the resulting space. The central result is that the scaling transformation $ψ_α(f)(n)=αf(n)$ is expansive on the complexity space $(\C,d_\C)$ if and only if $α\neq 1$.
